visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of noodles being lifted from a deep bowl of beef soup with dark broth and green vegetables. The lighting is bright and highlights the steam rising. Then, the camera cuts to a high-angle wide shot of a spacious restaurant interior. Several customers are seated at wooden tables, and a large, intricate wooden architectural structure hangs from the high ceiling. Sunlight enters through large glass windows in the background. (2) A male waiter wearing a green short-sleeved uniform, black apron, and a black face mask carries a tray and places a dish on a green marble-patterned table. The setting transitions to a close-up of a bowl of beef noodles. A white spoon scoops the dark, rich broth, showing its clarity and depth. Thick slices of beef with visible grain are lifted by chopsticks, followed by a large portion of curly noodles being pulled from the soup. White text overlays appear at the bottom. (3) The focus shifts to a dry noodle dish topped with a fried egg, sliced meat, and chili sauce. A hand uses a spoon to scoop the sauce and chicken, revealing the reddish-brown peanuts and scallions on top. Chopsticks lift the noodles which are now coated in a thick, savory sauce. The camera captures the breaking of the semi-cooked egg yolk, which flows over the noodles. Green cucumber shreds and orange crab roe are seen on another plate of noodles. (4) A platter of sliced golden-brown pork rolls is shown, followed by a close-up of a single roll being held by chopsticks, showing the egg and meat filling. Next, a pan-fried bun is held over a white plate, and as it is pressed, clear juice bursts from the bottom. A cross-section of the bun reveals a savory meat and scallion filling. (5) The dessert phase features a sweet, shredded pastry topped with crushed peanuts and condensed milk. Chopsticks pull the layers apart, showing its crispy and fibrous texture. The final scenes show a spoon scooping hot and sour soup with various ingredients like wood ear mushrooms and bamboo shoots, and a bowl of small marinated quail eggs. The video concludes with a blurred view of the restaurant interior followed by a shot of the storefront exterior with signboards in a city street under a clear sky.
